info.name: MCP Connector
info.summary: Model Context Protocol server — exposes owncloud.online to AI assistants
info.description:
Turns owncloud.online into a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, editors, agents) can list, read, search, write, share and tag files, and — for admins — manage users and groups, all as the authenticated user and subject to the same ownCloud permissions.
The endpoint speaks Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC at /apps/oco_mcp/mcp. It is read-only by default; set the app config "oco_mcp enable_write yes" (occ) to allow write and management tools. Note that enable_write arms write tools instance-wide for every token (and user/group management for every admin token) unless the app config "write_groups" (comma-separated group IDs) limits it to members of those groups. Authentication uses HTTP Basic with an ownCloud app/device token; credentials are revalidated per request and browser cookie sessions are rejected.
Modified by BW-Tech GmbH for owncloud.online (PHP 8.4).
